explicit_star_representation.exact_algebra: In this basis all matrices have only diagonal and first-row entries; the six diagonal entries satisfy d4=d1^3 (zero-based positions), the other five diagonal coordinates are arbitrary in F9, and the five off-diagonal first-row entries are arbitrary in F9. The algebra has F3-dimension 20 and its scalar matrices are precisely F3*I.
explicit_star_representation.socle: Every nonzero invariant subspace contains the line (0,1,i,0,0,0): the explicit complete invariant flag gives a common eigenline and the five nonsplit extensions exclude all other common eigencharacters.

socle_source_evaluations.meaning: The two actual K-element evaluations define a map on H1(K) because their scalar characters are 1. On the two Frobenius-conjugate essential lines, the map is [[i,-i],[-1,-1]], with inverse [[i,1],[-i,1]].

scope: Only the stated concrete character is treated. Every action is reconstructed from the eleven actual F23 source words. The algebra comparison and invariant flags give exact finite evidence; no general unequal-field rank theorem or full-pure-braid image theorem is asserted.
